summary: First full test iteration of REST-OS. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests passed covering auth, menu CRUD, categories, orders lifecycle with step enforcement, cross-cashier isolation (403), 60s edit window, calls, ratings, shifts, reports, audit, settings, owner-only RBAC. Frontend: customer QR flow at /t/1 works end-to-end (language switcher incl. Arabic RTL on <html>, category/search filters, item sheet with required options, qty, note, add-to-cart, submit, order-confirmation modal with order_number, My Orders list, call buttons). Cashier login lands on /cashier; a second customer tab placing an order appears on the cashier board without refresh (websocket OK); Accept + step-by-step advance to closed works; shift start/end summary renders. Owner login lands on /owner and all 7 tabs render (orders, menu, staff, reports, tables, auditLog, settings). Cashier navigating to /owner is correctly redirected to /cashier.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~770 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting into routers (auth, orders, menu, settings, calls, shifts, reports) for maintainability.
WebSocket endpoint at /api/ws has no auth check — anyone can connect and receive broadcasts incl. order_updated for other cashiers' orders. Consider token-gating.
settings.update_one upserts with partial doc but does not re-broadcast only the diff; acceptable but note missing index on settings.key.

end_shift computes total_cash from orders filtered by accepted_by + created_at>=started_at; orders accepted but not paid still skipped — intended, but orders_count includes unpaid orders which may be confusing.
edit_order recomputes totals correctly but does not append to history array; audit log exists but history field loses edit traceability.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends 5-attempt lockout).
JWT exp set to 7 days with no refresh/rotation mechanism.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed runs on startup (users + 15 menu items). Tests created a few TEST_ prefixed menu items / staff / orders that remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://table-service-33.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth via Bearer token stored in localStorage 'restos_token'. All data-testids are kebab-case (e.g. lang-id/en/ar, menu-search-input, menu-item-{id}, item-sheet, option-{group}-{label}, add-to-cart-btn, open-cart-btn, submit-order-btn, order-confirmation, confirmation-order-number, my-order-{order_number}, call-help-btn/call-bill-btn/call-clean-btn, order-card-{number}, accept-btn-{number}, advance-btn-{number}, edit-order-btn-{number}, save-edit-btn, start-shift-btn/end-shift-btn, owner-tab-{orders|menu|staff|reports|tables|auditLog|settings}). Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
